Thinking Cap: Trap-adjacent: a 1-mana Detective equip (+1/+2, equip-for-1) that's fine with ~5-6 detectives but a liability otherwise — over-committing to augmentation cost drafters games (LoL/Numot). 50.5% GIH, -4.4 IWD. Play one or two in a dense detective deck; cut it for real interaction.
Branch of Vitu-Ghazi: Filler land — LoL calls it unplayable but the 52.5% GIH is passable. A colorless-only land that can be a disguise 2/2 body and later burst two mana is marginal fixing at best. Only take it if you need bodies or a flexible late land; usually a real dual or spell is better.
Commercial District: Solid dual land. Enters tapped but adds R/G and surveils on ETB, smoothing Gruul or any red/green base with minor selection. 54.7% GIH and 72% play — a strong fixer you're happy to first-pick-among-lands and run in-color.
Elegant Parlor: Solid Boros dual land — the RW surveil-tapland is a premium fixer worth an early pick, smoothing draws and enabling graveyard/disguise synergies. 55% GIH and a strong 58% OH WR; grab these to firm up any two-color RW manabase.
Escape Tunnel: Sharply underrated — the experts unanimously call it the set's best fixing and arguably a top-10 common. 94% play and 55.8% GIH for a land is remarkable; enables splashes and double-color, with a real unblockable finisher mode. Take it early over marginal spells.
Hedge Maze: Solid Simic dual land — enters tapped but fixes GU and surveils to smooth draws and feed the graveyard. 55.8% GIH and 78% play reflect fixing value, not card power; the high GIH is a mana-consistency artifact. Good early pickup for two-color/splash decks in its colors.
Lush Portico: Solid GW dual land. Fixes both colors and surveils on entry to smooth draws and fuel the graveyard, cheap enough downside for the tapland — 55.5% GIH and 78% play rate. A high, near-automatic pick in Selesnya; the surveil is real value.
Meticulous Archive: Premium WU dual land. Taps for W or U and surveils 1 on ETB — great fixing that smooths draws in Azorius; 54.5% GIH and a strong OH WR reflect the mana-consistency value. Prioritize early to lock in the WU manabase.
Public Thoroughfare: Near-unplayable fixing: an enters-tapped any-color land that taxes you an untapped permanent or sacrifices itself — "fatal in a die-roll format" (LR). 52.3% GIH. Only justifiable in a greedy 3-color Grixis/UR splash; otherwise leave it in the pack.
Raucous Theater: Solid — the RB surveil dual. Enters tapped but fixes Rakdos mana and surveils 1 to smooth draws and fuel the graveyard. 54.7% GIH with positive IWD and 68% play; these tapped duals are quietly good in a two-color format. Grab it if you're base BR; fine speculative fixing.
Scene of the Crime: Marginal fixer. Guides split — a preview 'real playable' the retro called unplayable, Numot's 18th-land at best; enters tapped, fixes awkwardly, and cashes for a card late. 54.3% GIH is respectable but it's a fixing/gas filler, not a priority pick.
Shadowy Backstreet: Solid WB dual land — the same strong tapland template (surveil 1) for Orzhov. Positive IWD, 72% play rate; take it to smooth your manabase and feed surveil/graveyard payoffs. A clean, always-fine fixing pick in WB.
Thundering Falls: Solid UR dual — enters tapped but surveils, so it fixes and smooths for free. 55.5% GIH with strong OH is excellent for a land; take it highly in any Izzet deck as premium fixing that also feeds the graveyard. C+ undersells it.
Undercity Sewers: Solid Dimir dual land — taps in for UB fixing plus a surveil-1 that smooths draws and enables graveyard synergies. +3.0 IWD and 73% play show real consistency value; take it early to lock fixing, but it's a land, not a spell — value it as fixing.
Underground Mortuary: Solid BG dual land. Fixes both colors and surveils on entry, feeding Golgari's graveyard synergies while smoothing draws — 55.5% GIH with +2.5 IWD and 74% play rate. A strong near-automatic pick in any Golgari deck.
Case File Auditor: Niche enchantment/Case payoff. A 1/4 that digs six deep for enchantments and fixes Case spells — a fine wall with upside, but 54% GIH on a 41% play rate marks it as a role-player that needs enchantment density. Solid defensive body in the right WX build.
Wojek Investigator: Premium white rare (LR: A): a 2/4 flying vigilance angel that blocks nearly everything AND drips Clues whenever you're behind on cards. 60.3% GIH, 1.4 ALSA, 94% play — it stabilizes and draws simultaneously. A top-tier Azorius/Boros/Orzhov pick; take it early.
Sudden Setback: Role-player counter/bounce. Putting any spell or nonland permanent top-or-bottom of library is flexible interaction, but four mana at instant speed and letting them choose the destination softens it. 53.2% GIH, 32% play rate. A fine sideboard-flex answer for control blue, not a maindeck staple.
Surveillance Monitor: Good blue engine. A 3/3 for four that collect-evidences on ETB and turns every future collect-evidence into a flying Thopter — a token generator Numot rates in Golgari and as a CE enabler. 56.3% GIH, B grade, 80% play; multiples late signal an open lane.
Case of the Gorgon's Kiss: Trap-ish removal Case. One mana to kill a damaged creature is conditional, and the solve (three creatures to graveyards) rarely flips for the 4/4 deathtouch-lifelink body. 49% GIH, negative IWD — a fringe black playable that needs a sacrifice-heavy deck to justify.
Clandestine Meddler: Middling black uncommon — a 3/2 that suspects a creature (making it an aggressive menace attacker) and surveils on suspect attacks. 52.9% GIH and flat IWD mark it as a synergy role-player for suspect/aggro black; fine body, unexciting payoff. C is fair.
Torch the Witness: Premium red removal and LR's "mythic uncommon of the format" — scalable XR that deals 2X (Shock/kill-a-4/kill-a-6) and investigates on overkill, in one color so it fits every red deck. 59.9% GIH, +4.4 IWD, 92% play; just remember it's a sorcery. First-pick-caliber.
Break Out: Trap. A dig spell that only cheats out mana-value-2-or-less creatures, so it's high-variance and often just an expensive tutor-to-hand — 48.9% GIH, negative IWD, 7.2% play rate. Not worth a slot even in RG creatures; skip.
Kraul Whipcracker: Solid BG two-drop with removal upside. A 3/2 reach that kills an opposing token on ETB — great against the format's Clue/Detective/Thopter tokens, dead when they have none. 57.4% GIH and +4.7 IWD show the body plus flexible answer earn a real early pick in Golgari.
Undercover Crocodelf: Fine but unexciting UG common: a 5/5 that Investigates on combat damage, with disguise flexibility for a surprise blocker/attacker. 54.1% GIH, +0.1 IWD — a solid curve-topper that generates a Clue, but nothing spectacular. A reliable Simic body, mid-to-late pick.
Maverick Thopterist: Strong UR playable — near-premium. Five mana (often less with improvise off Clues) for a 2/2 plus two 1/1 flyers is excellent go-wide value and evasion (LR: A-). 59.6% GIH, +6.4 IWD, B+ grade. Fuels Warleader's Call and artifact synergies; a high pick in Izzet.
Treacherous Terrain: Splashable red finisher. Eight mana is steep but landcycling means it's never a dead card early, and it closes games by burning for the opponent's land count. 54.1% GIH with a wide OH/GD split shows it's a late-game topdeck; a fine RG/ramp closer plus fixing.
Mystery Key: Niche blue role-player. Equip-one to draw three on a connect is powerful card advantage, but it needs an evasive or unblocked creature and does nothing on defense. 37% play rate; the positive IWD (+2.1) shows upside in aggressive UW/UB tempo, but it's a build-toward, not a staple.
